Exercise 10. a) Five: a meeting of ministers, news of local news, economy (tourism), culture, weather. b) Water ministers from several Arab countries, in Amman yesterday; discussed the water shortage in the region and agreed on a common five-year plan; The next meeting will be in Rabat. c) The police found a six-year-old boy who was lost at the market yesterday; He's fine, and he came back to his family at night.
d) The 12 %; most came from Europe. e) The Arab music festival; participation of artists of 15 countries;

the first concert is expected more than 3.000 People. f) North: cloudy with light rains; Center: mild; South: hot, up to 40 degrees to Aswan. g) Formulas: ⁧إليكم أهم العناوين⁩ · ⁧قال المتحدث باسم⁩ … ⁧إن⁩ · ⁧وأضاف أن⁩ · ⁧أعلنت الشرطة أنها⁩ · ⁧ووفقًا للشرطة⁩ · ⁧وأشار⁩ … ⁧إلى أن⁩ · ⁧ومن المتوقع أن⁩ · ⁧وإلى حالة الطقس⁩ · ⁧هذه نهاية النشرة⁩ . Mona worked at the bank; now works in a travel agency ( ⁧شركة سياحة⁩ ). Next month he will go to Aswan with a group of Italian tourists. Hind says "beata te" because she has never been to Aswan. b) But...-š: ⁧ما شفتكيش⁩ · ʿumri but-: ⁧عمري ما شفت أسوان⁩ · present with ⁧بـ⁩ : ⁧بتشتغلي⁩ , ⁧بشتغل⁩ · future: ⁧هنسافر⁩ · question at the bottom: ⁧كنتي فين؟⁩ (also ⁧عاملة إيه؟⁩ ) · demonstration after name: ⁧الشغل ده⁩ . c) g: ⁧بجد⁩ (bi-gadd), ⁧الجاي⁩ (ig-gayy), ⁧مجموعة⁩ ( magmūʿit); ⁧ق⁩ read ʾ: ⁧بقالي⁩ ( baʾāli). d) Apart from pronunciation and termination: ⁧الحمد لله⁩ , ⁧كنت⁩ , ⁧عند خالتي⁩ , ⁧البنك⁩ , ⁧شركة سياحة⁩ , ⁧الشهر⁩ , ⁧مع⁩ , ⁧أسوان⁩ , ⁧من إيطاليا⁩ . Exercise 14. a) He hardly understands why the speaker speaks fast and he tries to understand every word. Karīm advises him: at the first listen only the topic; the second names and numbers (who, where, when, how), to be noted; do not stop at the unknown words, because formulas repeat each day. Karīm he learned French and Italian with radio, listening to the news in the car twice a day: once to understand, one for words. Condition: Arabic radio and coffee paid by Luca. b) They figured out the news, not the people on the street. The fuṣḥā is used in books, news and official speeches; Every country has its own dialect at home and on the street. Many Arabs understand Egyptian through movies and series. Now they will learn only to recognize him; They'll choose at the end of the level. The sounds: the ǧīm pronounced g, qāf pronounced as hamza. c)
